newsitem.title: USA: PT Pasifik Satelit Nusantara Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: PT Pasifik Satelit Nusantara Q3 loss.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Results shown in U.S. generally accepted accounting principles in U.S. dollars.
Company has weighted average of 72.0 million shares outstanding under U.S. accounting principles.
Each ADS represents three shares of PT Pasifik Satelit common stock.
Company completed an initial public offering of 3,650,000 American Depository Shares on June 10, 1996.

Under Indonesian accounting principles, the company's third quarter net income increased to $143,537 in 1996 from $122,919 in 1995. In the nine month period under Indonesian accounting standards, the company reported net income of $44,899 in 1996 compared with a loss of $2.93 million in the 1995 period.
